caption:
Day 1 review of your life: 10/10

Reviewed after one day. The sky at 5 p.m. carried the score.

People judged a longer painful trial that ended better as the one to repeat: evaluations are often dominated by the worst and the final moments (Kahneman, Fredrickson, Schreiber & Redelmeier, 1993, Psychological Science, doi:10.1111/j.1467-9280.1993.tb00589.x). The 40 percent in the card is part of the joke, not data.

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.

#GTA6 #review #selfknowledge #naos
alt: A review card from an invented outlet, REVIEWER WHO HASN'T SLEPT. DAY 1 OF YOUR LIFE, 10/10. PROS: graphics (the sky at 5 p.m.), soundtrack (a friend laughing). CONS: no fast travel, 40% of runtime picking what to watch, mom's side quest still open, reviewer has not left the couch. At the bottom: Would live again. How a day ends colors how you remember it. A figure with white eyes and no hands, eyes happy.
